verdict.rationale: Running a SaaS equity and fund platform headlessly via an API or CLI is a fair axis, but the evidence only describes UI click-paths and first-party HRIS integrations. The OpenAPI probe found nothing at any candidate path, and an llms.txt docs index is not a headless or CI execution capability. No CLI, API, or CI mode is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
